brief.title: Kessler Ring
brief.premise: On a spinning orbital habitat that cannot receive help from Earth for a generation, an air-quality inspector finds that the ring's oxygen budget has been falsified, and must decide whom to tell before the ration vote.
constraints: No teleportation or instantaneous travel of any kind.

world.name: Kessler Ring
world.description: Kessler Ring is a spinning orbital habitat cut off from Earth, where oxygen, gravity and rations are managed by hand-checked tables and the Air Board.

locations.name: Spin Deck
locations.description: The habitat's residential cylinder, where centrifugal gravity keeps one full G at the rim.

locations.name: Algae Vault
locations.description: A sealed farm of photosynthetic tanks that produces the ring's oxygen and food.

locations.name: Dock Nine
locations.description: The only docking spar, used by supply tugs from the lunar depot.

locations.name: Ration Office
locations.description: The administrative hub where oxygen and food quotas are calculated from printed tables.

factions.name: Air Board
factions.description: Technocrats who set oxygen quotas for each deck.

factions.name: Rim Union
factions.description: Residents of the Spin Deck who organise ration strikes.

factions.name: Tug Guild
factions.description: Pilots who ferry supplies between Dock Nine and the lunar depot.

rules.statement: No ship from Earth can reach the ring for twenty-five years; only slower tugs from the lunar depot can.
Gravity exists only on the Spin Deck rim; the Algae Vault and Dock Nine are weightless.
All quota calculations are done from hand-checked printed tables, because the ring's controllers can only run fixed programs.
Oxygen stored in tanks loses ten percent each year to leakage.

history.name: Ring Construction
history.description: Engineers spun up the ring and seeded the Algae Vault from lunar stock.

history.name: The Cutoff
history.description: An embargo on Earth shipping began the twenty-five-year isolation, leaving only lunar tugs to supply Dock Nine.

history.name: The First Ration Strike
history.description: Rim Union workers halted deliveries to the Ration Office to demand larger oxygen quotas.

history.name: The Dock Nine Leak
history.description: A cracked tank at Dock Nine vented a season's oxygen reserve, which the Air Board hid from the ring.

conflicts.name: The Quota Fraud
conflicts.description: The Rim Union suspects the Air Board of falsifying oxygen quotas.

conflicts.name: The Tug Tolls
conflicts.description: The Tug Guild demands higher payment from the Air Board for carrying emergency oxygen.

characters.name: Noor Adeyemi
characters.description: An air-quality inspector who measures oxygen on every deck by hand and logs each reading in a paper journal.
characters.motivation: To make sure the ring's oxygen figures are true before the ration vote.
characters.goal: Put her measured readings in front of the ration vote.
characters.flaw: Freezes when forced to choose a side.
characters.internal_conflict: She fears the truth will start a riot.
characters.external_conflict: The Air Board controls the printed tables she must reconcile her readings against.

abilities.name: Leak-sense
abilities.description: Notices a pressure drop by the pop in her ears before the gauges move.

characters.arc: Noor stops auditing alone and brings the Rim Union into the open.

characters.name: Halvard Brecht
characters.description: Director of the Air Board, who works from the Ration Office and has hidden the Dock Nine leak from the ring.
characters.motivation: To prevent panic until the lunar tugs can bring replacement oxygen.
characters.goal: Keep the leak out of the ration vote.
characters.flaw: Believes the ring cannot handle the truth.
characters.internal_conflict: He knows hiding the leak shortens everyone's margin.

abilities.name: Table-memory
abilities.description: Recalls every printed quota table from memory.

characters.arc: Halvard is forced to publish the true figures when the readings spread.

characters.name: Ilse Moreau
characters.description: A tug pilot who flies supply runs between Dock Nine and the lunar depot.
characters.motivation: To get fair payment for emergency oxygen runs.
characters.goal: Force the Air Board to pay the Guild's higher toll.
characters.flaw: Prefers a fight to a negotiation.
characters.internal_conflict: She is tempted to sell the leak story to the Rim Union.
characters.external_conflict: The Air Board stalls on payment.

abilities.name: Zero-g docking
abilities.description: Docks tugs at Dock Nine by hand in weightlessness.

characters.arc: Ilse learns that leverage needs allies.

relationships.description: Noor's readings undermine Halvard's quota tables.
relationships.conflict: He wants her readings kept off the record.

relationships.description: Ilse ferries Noor's sample tanks to the lunar depot for testing.
Halvard owes Ilse's Guild payment for emergency oxygen runs.

storyboard.title: Kessler Ring
storyboard.logline: Noor proves the ring's oxygen budget has been falsified and forces the truth to the ration vote.

scenes.title: The Readings
scenes.summary: Noor measures oxygen on the Spin Deck and finds the deck's readings lower than the printed tables claim.
scenes.goal: Check the printed tables against her readings.
scenes.conflict: The Air Board tables are the only official record.
scenes.outcome: Her hand readings are consistently below the tables.

scenes.title: The Samples
scenes.summary: Noor asks Ilse to carry sample tanks to the lunar depot for testing; Ilse agrees in exchange for support on the Guild's toll.
scenes.goal: Get the samples out for testing.
scenes.conflict: Ilse distrusts the Air Board and wants payment.
scenes.outcome: Ilse takes the sample tanks on her next run to the lunar depot.

scenes.title: The Results
scenes.summary: Ilse returns from the lunar depot with the test results, which show the stored oxygen is far below the figure in the tables.
scenes.conflict: The run takes weeks on the slow tugs and the Board stalls Ilse's payment.
scenes.outcome: Noor holds independent proof that the stored oxygen is below the tables' figure.

scenes.title: The Admission
scenes.summary: Noor confronts Halvard with the test results; he admits the Dock Nine leak was hidden and begs her to wait until the lunar tugs arrive.
scenes.conflict: He insists the ring cannot take the truth.
scenes.outcome: Halvard refuses to publish the figures and Noor decides to take them to the Rim Union.

scenes.title: The Union
scenes.summary: Noor brings the figures to the Rim Union, who call a ration strike.
scenes.goal: Get the Union to demand the true figures.
scenes.outcome: The Union calls a ration strike and demands a public count.

scenes.title: The Public Count
scenes.summary: At the ration vote the Air Board's printed tables are read aloud beside Noor's readings and the tug test results, and Halvard is forced to concede the leak.
scenes.goal: Force a public count before the vote.
scenes.conflict: Halvard tries to adjourn the vote.
scenes.outcome: The ring sees the true figures before voting.

scenes.title: The New Quota
scenes.summary: The ring votes a shared oxygen quota based on the true figures, and Halvard publishes the corrected tables.
scenes.goal: Agree a quota the ring can survive on.
scenes.conflict: Rim residents and the Board still distrust each other.
scenes.outcome: The ring begins rationing from honest figures, and the tugs prepare a lunar resupply.

evidence_summary: The storyboard follows a coherent causal chain consistent with the world's rules, the brief and the cast.
